mandatory_prerequisites: An eligible installed seed with original source/lock and exact dependency provenance must be sealed before first baseline.
Execution freeze must bind these reviewed infrastructure hashes and immutable seed/final image IDs.
Actual Docker before-start and in-container boundaries must pass; this static review does not certify an uncreated container.
Run the three repetitions sequentially as predeclared and retain every ineligible or unsuccessful result.
No joint result may be claimed before independent raw-outcome audit of all completed repetitions.
evidence_limitations: Jest passed case results are the execution measure; no independent hook/call-phase instrumentation is added.
Coverage/cache binary contents are inventory-only; raw Jest JSON and logs are embedded.
One fixed source-policy reversion; three technical repetitions are not three independent vulnerabilities.
